subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: what can i teach you asked nasiruddin we dont know replied the students you are students but you do not know anything so i cant teach you anything said nasiruddin Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation "What can I teach you?" asked Nasiruddin. "We don't know," replied the students. "You are students but you do not know anything. So, I can't teach you anything," said Nasiruddin. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book
